working-directory.description: Directory containing the Cargo workspace root and rust-toolchain.toml.

clippy.description: Runs cargo clippy with -D warnings when true.

clippy-arguments.description: Whitespace-separated cargo clippy arguments placed before the enforced "-- -D warnings".

cargo-deny.description: Runs cargo deny check with the caller's deny.toml when true.

cargo-deny-checks.description: Optional whitespace-separated cargo-deny check names (advisories, bans, licenses, sources). Empty runs every check.

cargo-deny-version.description: cargo-deny version installed from a prebuilt binary.

sqlx-offline.description: Exports SQLX_OFFLINE=true to clippy so sqlx query macros use committed .sqlx metadata.

sqlx-prepare-check.description: Runs cargo sqlx prepare --check against a throwaway Postgres container in a separate job when true. Needs Docker on the runner.

sqlx-prepare-arguments.description: Whitespace-separated arguments for cargo sqlx prepare, before the enforced --check.

sqlx-migrations-source.description: Optional migrations directory, relative to working-directory, applied with sqlx migrate run before the prepare check.

sqlx-cli-version.description: sqlx-cli version installed from a prebuilt binary through cargo-binstall.

cargo-binstall-version.description: cargo-binstall version used to install sqlx-cli.

sqlx-postgres-image.description: Postgres image started with docker run for the sqlx prepare check.

sqlx-container-image.description: Deprecated and ignored. The sqlx job no longer runs in a job container; a non-default value only logs a deprecation warning. Removed in the next major.

enable-cache.description: Restores and saves the Cargo registry and target cache with Swatinem/rust-cache when true. Set false for cold-build validation or runners without cache service access.

upload-diagnostics.description: Uploads diagnostics artifacts when true. Set false for local act smoke tests that cannot emulate upload-artifact.
